items.body: Lowers the `engines.node` floor of `@williamthorsen/telefactor` from `>=26` to `>=24`, so that the next release continues to support Node 24, an LTS line that remains supported until April 2028.
Drops support for Node.js 24 and 25 by raising the `engines.node` requirement of `@williamthorsen/telefactor` to `>=26`.

items.description: Licenses the repo and the `_workspace` scaffold under ISC by adding a `LICENSE` file and replacing `UNLICENSED` in both manifests, so that a library created from the scaffold can be published. (#8)

Renames the root package to `telefactor` and the `_workspace` scaffold to `telefactor-workspace-template`, resets both to version 0.0.0 with empty changelogs, and points their homepage, bugs, and repository URLs at `williamthorsen/telefactor`. (#8)
